details: @chatbridgeworld/baileys is not the upstream WhatsApp Web API library @whiskeysockets/baileys: it reuses the canonical "baileys" basename under the unrelated @chatbridgeworld scope, with no repository, no license and no claim of any relationship to the upstream project. The publish 0.0.0-stage is a name-reservation placeholder with no executable content — it ships only a 346-byte package.json containing {"version":"0.0.0-stage","stub":true,"description":"Temporary package placeholder for staged publishing"} and a README headed "Temporary Holding Version" that states an "operational version to replace this" is awaiting a staged release. There are no lifecycle hooks, no scripts, no bin entries, no dependencies and no network destinations in this version, so this record describes the impersonating name rather than a payload. An earlier release under the same @chatbridgeworld/baileys name carried malicious content. The name should be treated as compromised: any non-stub release of @chatbridgeworld/baileys should be assumed to deliver a payload, and consumers resolving "baileys" should use @whiskeysockets/baileys only.
